program.name: Steady Strength
program.subject: Calm strength
program.blurb: Slow supersets, a quiet core circuit and a long yin finish, with steady breathing all the way.
program.about: Push, pull and legs done at a calm, steady pace. Each session is a slow superset, a core circuit of dead bugs, bird dogs and planks that is held rather than rushed, and a yin finish of long floor holds. Level II moves you one weight up. Level III adds a three-second lowering to every rep, while the core block adds reps and the yin holds get longer. Nothing here should leave you breathless.
program.split: Push / pull / legs: slow supersets, core and a yin finish
program.gear: A pair of dumbbells or a kettlebell, a mat, and a pull-up bar on pull days.
